newsitem.title: UK: Boots gains after top-of-range results.
newsitem.headline: Boots gains after top-of-range results.

text.p: Shares in Boots Co Plc were marked higher in early trading on Thursday after the drugstore operator posted profits at the top end of the range of analysts' forecasts coupled with upbeat comments on its trading performance.
The stock was quoted up 8-1/2p at 629-1/2 by 0805 GMT.
"It was a strong set of results, at the top end of expectations," said one analyst, who cited the 12 percent rise in profit at the core Boots the Chemists chain as particularly promising.

Boots posted a rise in pre-tax profit to 239.2 million stg in the first half from 218.7 million stg a year before, compared with analyst expectations mostly in a range between 225.0 million stg and 241 million.
The dividend was raised to 6.2p from 5.7p, in line with expectations.
"We are encouraged by the general improvement in the retail trade," said chairman Sir Michael Angus.
"The pre-Christmas period retains its importance for the company as a whole. We are confident of good seasonal sales despite an increasingly competitive environment."
